title: Work-life balance insight → LinkedIn English post
user_request: Aprendi que trabalhar mais horas não significa entregar mais valor
expected_output: More hours ≠ more value. It took me longer than I'd like to admit to truly internalize that. Sustainable output isn't born from grinding — it's born from clarity, focus, and knowing when to step away. Your best work often comes right after rest. Protect your energy like it's your most valuable asset. Because it is.
notes: Input: Portuguese, work-life balance insight. Output: English LinkedIn post. Tone: reflective, practical, slightly provocative. Short punchy sentences.
